run_sample_2dseg_query: run the script to sample 2D segmentation queries from training images for a given scene
run_Sample2dsegQuery_main: run Sample2dsegQuery.main to sample up to 10 queries per instance from training image set
review_Sample2dsegQuery: review the Sample2dsegQuery class that splits frames into seen and novel views for evaluation
review_train_valid_split: review the logic that splits frames into training and validation sets using every 5th frame
review_query_sampling: review the query sampling logic that groups queries by instance ID and samples a subset
